purpose: Evaluate the versioned angiospermae trnV-atpE reverse-primer correction with unchanged assembly policy.

synthetic.input_format: All 151-base windows in both orientations from the old source interval plus 100 bp flanks; Phred40; no mutations.
assertions: Search all emitted standard and uncertain records for the exact independently extracted corrected interval; report every discrepancy and status.
The legacy canonical source interval is above max_length1000 and cannot be admitted as an in-range product.
Do not assume the old panel emits zero shorter alternative graph paths; enumerate them if present.
Synthetic source reconstruction is an assembler diagnostic, not evidence for a real-sample haplotype.

real.reads: Same previously verified first 1000000 raw R1 FASTQ records for each accession.
real.controls: Other nine primer definitions are identical; compare each by literal sequence SHA-256, multiplicity, assembly_status and search-limit diagnostics.
real.changed_target: Enumerate all before/after trnV-atpE records; report exact and partial independent-reference matches separately. Output changes for this redesigned assay are not an unchanged-assay retention comparison.
claim_limits: A matching public reference establishes independent sequence/target support, not full phasing in the sequenced sample.
Acer opalus references are related-species proxies for Acer monspessulanum.
No assembly admission gates, repeat policy, retention bounds or output inclusion policy change.
Runtime results from these bounded checks do not replace collaborator performance assessment before release.
